dedupe_keys.name: 3d city model with material properties in high resolution for urban simulations

description: A University of Maribor team publishes a high-resolution 3D city model for Celje, Slovenia. Two public files give an OBJ mesh of 914 buildings and an MTL material definition under CC BY 4.0. The provider says aerial LiDAR and building outlines define geometry, while TABULA typologies supply statistical roof, wall, window and floor properties. Triangle labels and material fields include solar absorptance, heat-transfer coefficients and window solar heat-gain coefficients. These inputs can support urban thermal, radiation or building-energy simulations, and they pair with the separately deposited hourly thermal-load results. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Celje model. A limitation is that typology-derived materials are not measured facade properties of every building. The public page does not give a building-year snapshot, triangle count, positional accuracy or field validation against indoor energy use. The OBJ and MTL were not downloaded or parsed, and simulation compatibility was not tested.
